data_window: 2026-08-14 00:00 to 2026-08-17 11:15 Asia/Shanghai. GitHub Search API raw responses were saved under /tmp/radar_2026_08_17_*.json and selected repository README/content audits under /tmp/radar_2026_08_17_repo_audit/.
source_summary: git fetch origin succeeded on main and the worktree already had unrelated frontend/deploy changes that were preserved unstaged. Discovery used GitHub Search API queries for repositories created since 2026-08-14 matching AI agent, LLM app, RAG, MCP, workflow automation, browser agent, code agent, voice agent and copilot terms. Selected repository metadata, README files and root contents were fetched through the GitHub API. No third-party repository was cloned, installed, built, run, browser-tested, credential-tested, provider-tested, payment-tested, mobile-tested or security-scanned.
trend_observations: The freshest AI-native product activity is clustered around agent operating layers: durable memory engines, portable agent identity/governance, inline audit proxies, quota/token observability and desktop/mobile shells for coding-agent harnesses. DeepSeek Harness continues to attract plugin and distribution work, but the strongest items are the ones with concrete install/build paths, state models, CI or safety boundaries. A parallel enterprise-app cluster is moving from generic RAG demos toward admin consoles, tenant isolation, semantic query validation and operational dashboards.
assumptions: Scores are point-in-time editorial rankings based on GitHub metadata, README/root-content evidence, visible runnable surfaces, product shape, documentation completeness, safety posture and recent creation/update signals. Stars and forks are GitHub API snapshots rather than exact growth deltas. README claims were not independently runtime-verified. DSH ecosystem projects are ranked lower when they are lists, skins or prompt/skill collections rather than standalone product surfaces. No install, Docker, npm, pnpm, Bun, Cargo, Java, Python, Android, browser, provider, WeChat, database, payment or production deployment audit was performed.

top_projects.summary: Rust memory engine for AI agents with immutable content-addressed grains, CAL context assembly, governed self-improvement and durable journaled runs.
top_projects.audience: Agent platform builders and local-first teams that need fast, auditable memory inside voice, coding or workflow agents.
top_projects.ai_native_angle: Treats memory as an embedded agent substrate: provenance, recall, context assembly and replayable runs are built for model loops rather than a generic database wrapper.
top_projects.growth_signal: Created 2026-08-16 and updated 2026-08-17; root includes Cargo workspace, crates, adapters, extensive docs, SECURITY, CI badges and bilingual README.
top_projects.runnability: README describes install and Rust MSRV; source, lockfile and tests are visible. No cargo build, package install or recall benchmark was run.
top_projects.recommended_action: Run a small local memory file through CAL recall and inspect provenance/replay guarantees before embedding it in an agent.

skipped_projects.skip_reason: Useful ecosystem index with strong stars/forks, but it is a curated list/site rather than a directly runnable AI-native product.
Well-packaged agent skill collection, but the core artifact is writing-style procedures and installers rather than a product workflow with its own user surface.
Concrete voice-agent scenario, but appears to be a mock/demo finance collections implementation; payment/identity/safety claims need much stronger evidence.
Concept-heavy sovereign AI intake project with document-style README and limited visible product/runtime structure in this audit.
Activator/unlock positioning for AI apps is likely unsafe or policy-abusive and does not fit the product radar quality bar.
DSH skin/gallery work is UI customization rather than an AI-native product surface or agent workflow primitive.
